Name: Global
Description: Group containing global parameters that affect the overall behavior and appearance of the WaveShine node.

Name: Frame
Description: Specifies the current animation frame or time step for the wave simulation, allowing for frame-by-frame control or preview.

Name: Octaves
Description: Sets the number of detail layers (octaves) used in the wave pattern, increasing complexity and realism with higher values.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomization seed for generating unique wave patterns. Changing the seed produces different wave arrangements.

Name: Ripples
Description: Group containing parameters that control the appearance and animation of small-scale ripples on the water surface.

Name: Animation Speed
Description: Controls the speed at which ripples animate across the surface, affecting how quickly the pattern evolves over time.

Name: Size
Description: Sets the scale of individual ripples, with larger values producing broader, more widely spaced ripples.

Name: Amplitude
Description: Adjusts the height or intensity of the ripples, making them more or less pronounced.

Name: Direction
Description: Specifies the primary direction in which ripples travel, simulating wind or current-driven movement.

Name: Speed
Description: Controls the movement speed of the ripples, determining how fast they propagate across the surface.

Name: Wind Patch
Description: Group containing parameters for simulating localized wind effects, creating patches of intensified or varied wave activity.

Name: Intensity
Description: Sets the strength of the wind patch effect, increasing the impact of wind on the wave or ripple pattern.

Name: Animation Speed
Description: Controls the animation speed of the wind patch, affecting how quickly wind-driven changes occur.

Name: Size
Description: Determines the area covered by the wind patch, with larger values affecting a broader region of the surface.

Name: Contrast
Description: Adjusts the contrast of the wind patch effect, making the difference between calm and windy areas more or less pronounced.

Name: Lighting
Description: Group containing parameters for simulating lighting effects on the wave surface, such as sun position and brightness.

Name: Brightness
Description: Controls the overall brightness of the rendered wave surface, affecting how light or dark the result appears.

Name: Sun Azimuth
Description: Sets the horizontal angle of the sun, determining the direction of sunlight and resulting highlights or reflections.

Name: Sun Elevation
Description: Sets the vertical angle of the sun above the horizon, affecting the length and intensity of highlights and shadows on the waves.
